newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht steady, interbank rate falls late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht steady, interbank rate falls late.

text.p: The Thai baht was steady against the dollar in late trade on Monday as most players already squared positions ahead of the mid-year holiday, dealers said.
"Most people already squared their positions. Tuesday is also a holiday, so most players don't want to do anything today," said one dealer at a European bank.
Foreign exchange and money markets will be closed on Tuesday for the commercial banks' mid-year holiday.
The baht was quoted at 25.80/25.90 to the dollar late in the domestic market, unchanged from early morning.
In the offshore market, the baht was traded at 24.80/25.10 late against 23.90/24.40 early.
The baht/dollar one-month swap premium was at 65/95 satangs per dollar late in the offshore market and 25/30 in the domestic market.
The overnight interbank dropped to 13-15 percent late from 17-20 percent in the morning on rising liquidity, dealers said.
"Money supply was very high today especially in the non-resident baht accounts. This pushed down the interbank rate," said one money market dealer.
